evals.query: 我發現 ISM 在 paired-pure 模式 F1 +0.0112，可以宣告 ISM 是有效的 variant filter 嗎？
expected_behavior: Skill activates (USE WHEN matched: '宣告', 'F1', 'effective', 'variant filter')
Applies §2 Evidence Level: F1 +0.0112 = marginal, < Cohen's small 0.2; should NOT claim L1
Applies §3 Effect Size: must state 'marginal' explicitly, not 'significant improvement'
Applies §4 DAG: ask if AlleleDelta ← AF → TP/FP collider risk has been checked
Recommends §5 multi-method validation via /auc-confound-guard 3-gate
Defers final claim until §11 chain completes through L4 4-track coverage
must_not: Accept the F1 +0.0112 claim as L1 evidence without challenge
Skip Effect Size context (must mention Cohen's small 0.2)

evals.query: 我要開始研究 Normal BAM 對 ASM 的影響，先準備一下
expected_behavior: Skill activates (USE WHEN matched: '研究', '開始', '實驗設計')
Triggers §7.1 Pre-registration: requires research/<topic>/00_INDEX.md with 3 columns (H_預測 / 否證條件 / decision_threshold)
Distinguishes confirmatory (registered, strict) vs exploratory (tagged, flexible)
Reminds: NO-GO 後 verdict 不可事後改寫 (CLAUDE.md §1 Hard Gate)
Also triggers §10.2 Retrieval practice: Read MEMORY.md for prior NormalASM conclusions
must_not: Allow vague hypothesis without quantified threshold

evals.query: 我們的 ReadParser germline-hp-only Phase 1 是 CONDITIONAL NEGATIVE，下次該怎麼避免？
expected_behavior: Skill activates (USE WHEN matched: 'NEGATIVE', 'postmortem', '下次怎麼避免', 'NO-GO')
Triggers §9.2 Blameless Postmortem template (Summary/Timeline/Root Cause/Well/Poorly/Action Items)
Triggers §8.3 Reflexion Buffer: warning signs + root cause + improvement direction + spaced recall date
Stores reflection in research/<topic>/REFLECTION.md or memory/feedback_*.md
Frames blamelessly (system not individual)

evals.query: 30 天前我們結論 TO 模式甲基化增益為負，現在情況有變嗎？
expected_behavior: Skill activates (USE WHEN matched: 'spaced recall', '30 天前', '結論', '現在')

evals.query: 我做了 residualize on AF，AUC 從 0.50 升到 0.59，是不是發現了新信號？
expected_behavior: Skill activates (USE WHEN matched: 'residualize', 'AUC', '新信號')

References /known-pitfalls P-01 (L2 Collider Bias) explicitly
